releases.notes:
## 0.13.0: The new look

Every screen in the mod got a new coat of paint, shops and NPCs got signs to put their names on,
and the mailbox comes in every wood. Under that sits a pile of fixes, including one that kept
custom NPC models, NPC sounds and custom coin art from loading on 1.21.11.

### A new look

- **Title plates that fit the screen.** Steel for builder tools, brass for the bank, a light-up
  marquee for the games, a stamp for mail, parchment for quests, and wood for shops.
- **The slot machine, coin flip, mailbox, bounty board and ATM screens look like their blocks.**
  The mailbox screen uses the wood of the mailbox you opened.
- **Bounty notes are pinned to a cork board.** Click a note to take it. The notes slide and swing
  when you turn the page.
- **Money shows as the real coin on a dark field**, so a custom coin shows there too. Price boxes
  in shops, the Auction House and the trade screens use the same coin field.
- **Page bars on every list that has pages**, in place of the old scroll bars, and a white line
  under the active tab.
- **Waiting badges** for mail on the Inbox and Outbox tabs, uncollected money in the Shop Manager,
  and finished bounties.
- **A SOLD OUT stamp** on empty shop listings.
- The NPC editor's Talk tab is grouped into labelled boxes.
- The settings screen got real ON/OFF buttons, clearer value boxes, and a background on 1.21 and up.
- The coins floating above the ATM bob and spin, each on its own timing.

### Signs and name plates

- Shop owners pick a sign for their shop's name with the **Sign...** button in the Shop Manager.
- NPC builders pick the plate an NPC's name sits on in its talk window, on the Name tab of Appearance.
- **32 signs** come with the mod, including Copper, Cherry, Chalkboard, Ribbon, a flickering Neon
  and a twinkling Mystic, and a Painted sign in all 16 dye colours.
- Signs are pictures, so a resource pack can add more. The wiki shows how.

### Mailboxes in every wood

- Oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, bamboo, crimson and warped.
- A smaller, simpler mailbox made from Minecraft's own textures. Placed mailboxes keep working and
  just change their look.
- New recipe: five planks around a red dye, with a log of the same wood underneath.
- Axes break mailboxes faster, and each wood makes its own sound.

### Auction House

- The brass plate, new button icons, the shared page bar, and tooltips on the refresh and help
  buttons. List an Item and Place a Bid got the same treatment.
- Place a Bid shows the current and next bid as coins, and you type your bid in a coin field.
- **Rarity follows how valuable an item is.** Diamonds are Rare, netherite and Elytra are Epic, and
  an enchanted item goes up one step instead of two. The mod's own items have rarities now too:
  the Heart Crystal is Epic, a crate's rarity matches its name, and so on.

### Trading

- The trade screens got the brass plate, coin fields, and a Ready mark for both players.
- If either player changes the trade after the other confirmed, both confirms clear.
- Hover the other player's coin amount to see the exact number when it is shortened.

### Fixed

- On 1.21.11, custom NPC models, NPC sounds and custom coin art did not load. Packs already built
  on your computer rebuild by themselves.
- Amounts over 32,767 showed wrong on the slot machine, coin flip, loan, raffle, enchanter, auction
  listing, trade and shop screens.
- With My Listings open, a click on an item behind the popup could still buy it.
- The HUD coin and the bounty tracker's icon drew over chat messages. On 1.21.11 and up, the whole
  balance, route and bounty tracker HUDs did. Chat stays on top now.
- Renaming the coin did nothing until you turned its resource pack on by hand, and a renamed coin
  still said "coins" in five places.
- Claiming one auction listing with `/ah claim <id>` showed up in `/receipts` as "unspecified".
- Text typed into the settings search box did not show.

...

releases.notes:
## 0.11.0

### Crates got a makeover
New crate models with an open animation, one texture per tier. Thanks to @FFlash
for the art. The inventory icon is the crate itself now instead of a drawn
sprite, and it shows up that way in your hand, in item frames and on the ground.

Sounds follow the animation instead of firing all at once on the click: a heavy
wooden thud as it starts moving, the lid swinging up a second later with your
reward, and a thud as it shuts.

### Fixed worlds hanging on load
On 1.21.11 worlds would sit on the loading screen and never finish, and could
not be saved. Golden caches were looking for a spot the instant a chunk loaded,
which left the server waiting on itself.

### Fixed 1.21.11 resource loading
The mod shipped a pack.mcmeta that 1.21.11 reads as both a resource pack and a
data pack, and those two want opposite formats, so there was no version of the
file that worked. Fabric fills it in correctly on its own, so it is gone. The
NPC models pack also stopped rebuilding itself on every world join.

## 0.10.4

### Fixed
Three of the preset NPC skins had stray pixels in a corner of the skin file.
Resource packs like Just Expressions read that corner as
settings, so those NPCs came out with smeared faces.

### NPC editor
Move, Rotate and Size had a label running off the edge of the panel and a button
hanging off the bottom. The rows line up now.

releases.notes:
## 0.10.3

### Fixed
Special idle animations fired whenever they felt like it, including while a
player was mid conversation and while the NPC was walking somewhere. They only
play now when the NPC has nothing else on: nobody talking to it, nothing to
fight, not asleep, and standing still.

NPCs sat floating above seats from Create and furniture mods. They were not
sitting at all. Seat mods set the rider's pose when it mounts and we forced it
back to standing every tick, so the NPC stood on the seat's rider point.

Skin layers went muddy on NPCs when 3D Skin Layers was installed. Layer
rendering is handed off to other mods when they want it now.

Random lines in Window mode always showed the first line you typed instead of
cycling, and a line with no choices drew no buttons at all, so there was nothing
to click to close it.

### NPC editor
Move, Rotate and Size gains a Body Y row, for placing an NPC on a seat that sits
at an odd height. It shifts the model rather than the NPC, so it survives being
sat on something.

## 0.10.2

### Fixed
Renaming an NPC turned its nameplate back on, so you had to toggle it off again.
Picking one up and placing it did the same. Both leave your toggle alone now.

### NPC editor
The skin buttons and the pose buttons are both a single left/right cyclers now,
and the space that frees up on the Pose tab is now a live preview of the NPC in the
pose you just picked.

### Mail
A little secret added for the mail. A seasonal surprise.

releases.notes:
## 0.10.1

0.10.0 was tagged but never published, so everything in it is here too. If you are
coming from 0.9.0, this is the lot.

### Shops keep their contents when an NPC goes missing

Reported from a live server: NPCs vanishing "along with the money and inventory in
them". Shops were not deleted but the ability to access them was.

- Placing a shop NPC now tells you when you own a shop with no shopkeeper
- `/shop relink <id>` puts the NPC you are looking at behind one of your shops
- `/shop admin cleanup` now only reports. Acting on it needs `confirm`, and it
  checks every dimension instead of the one you are standing in

### Heart crystals

Eat one for an extra heart, up to two extra rows. Dying costs you one, down to
none, unless a server turns that off with `/hearts loseondeath false`.

| Where | Chance |
|---|---|
| Common Crate | 0.03% |
| Rare Crate | 0.09% |
| Epic Crate | 0.2% |
| Balloon | 0.1% |
| Golden Cache | 0.3% |

### Mail

Mailbox block, parcels as items, Inbox/Outbox, live trade button.

### Bring your own NPC model

Blockbench, GeckoLib export, import folder, editor. Plus server sharing.

### NPCs

Walk animations, daily schedules, and no-gravity NPCs that can actually move.

### World

Golden caches under oaks (1 in 3000, one at a time), balloons that wait for an
area, per-player balloons.
